purpose: Biome backdrops beneath actual rendered city models; no fabricated city buildings in artwork.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape backdrop for a tiny city selector thumbnail in the fantasy strategy game Peris. Create a single square image, low-poly 3D game art, broad simple faceted forms, restrained detail, soft daylight from upper left. Elevated isometric view toward distant terrain; flat empty clearing fills central 70% and foreground, with low hills around the top edge. A real 3D miniature city will be composited over the central clearing. No buildings, walls, people, UI, letters, frames, roads or water. Readable at 100 pixels. Terrain: temperate sage-green grassland clearing surrounded by sparse angular olive and deep-green trees at the edges, hazy green hills, warm natural earth. Original fantasy game art.
